title: Heavy duty and attractive.
text: Heavy duty and attractive.. Very nice, heavy duty trash can.  This is an attractive, sturdy trash can.  There is a trash bin inside which gives you the option to use a garbage bag or not.  I use a garbage bag.  You don't have to worry about the wind blowing this can over, it is heavy but not too have to relocate.  The only thing I would add to this waste can is a handle on the insert for easier lifting out of the bin.

product_metadata.title: Safco Products Evos Outdoor/Indoor Steel Trash Can 9933BL, Black, Perforated Galvanized Steel Panels, Stainless Steel Ashtray, 15 Gallon Capacity
features: MODERN STYLING. Evos Outdoor/Indoor Steel Trash Can with Ash Urn features four stylish perforated panels, four convenient openings and a built-in stainless steel ashtray that enhances high traffic areas while keeping them clean and litter free.

OUTDOOR/INDOOR USE. Manufactured with commercial-grade steel with a powder-coat finish, this waste container performs well in both outdoor and indoor conditions. Includes a chip and peel-resistant rigid plastic liner for easy maintenance.
HANDS-FREE DISPOSAL. Covered dome features four, 10 1/2"W x 6 1/2"H openings that let you discard waste without touching the lid, which may help reduce the spread of germs.
PRODUCT DIMENSIONS. Finished dimensions: 16"W x 16"D x 33 1/4"H. Weight: 43 lbs. Capacity: 15 gallons.

APPLICATIONS. Ideal outdoor garbage can for use on outdoor patios, meeting spaces, cafés, recreational and picnic areas, corporate and college campuses, boardwalks, tourist attractions, and other high traffic outdoor and indoor locations.
